name: Galicia Green Data Center (GAL1)
notes: GAL1 in Galicia has strategic-project status, construction license, four hectares of secured land and 25MWe granted power; construction scheduled Q2 2026 and operation targeted Q3 2027. Earlier reporting described the project as a 15MW carbon-neutral data center.

name: CESGA new datacenter / Galicia Supercomputing Center expansion
developer: CESGA / Xunta de Galicia; Copasa; Dominion
notes: New CESGA datacenter in A Sionlla/Santiago for Finisterrae IV, storage and quantum computing; Dominion case study states the center is prepared for IT loads up to 3.2MW.

name: Xunta de Galicia public-sector CPD at A Sionlla
notes: Regional government project for a new CPD in A Sionlla business park, Santiago de Compostela, over 8,000-10,000 sqm and intended as central infrastructure for autonomous-government cloud strategy.

name: Infotelecom Palma / Son Castelló data center
notes: Infotelecom says its new Palma data center in Son Castelló is live, connected with its Ciutadella and Maó centers, and includes rooftop solar covering up to 80% of the center's electricity consumption.

name: Vodafone Marratxí data center
notes: Marratxí municipal announcement says Vodafone selected the municipality for a new data center with Tier-3-equivalent certifications and redundant 10Gbps circuits; facility planned to host more than 500 Juniper servers.

name: IslaLink Palma/Mallorca cable landing data center
notes: IslaLink offers colocation services from its Palma de Mallorca cable landing station/data center, part of its Balearic connectivity infrastructure.

name: Casiopeia / Grupo Fotones Murcia data center campus
notes: DCD reports the Casiopeia project near the Espinardo university campus would deploy up to 140MW in two phases, with construction potentially starting in late 2027 and completion during 2028.

name: Cartagena Data Green
notes: Proposed Valle de Escombreras data center using cold from Enagás LNG regasification plant for high-density/AI workloads; civil works and thermal connection targeted for Q4 2026, testing around mid-2028 and commercial launch H1 2029.

name: Kumo/Murcia Data Center
notes: Kumo lists offices/data center presence in Murcia and Valencia; Uptime Institute certification page identifies Kumo/Murcia Data Center in Murcia, Spain.

name: ITRES Murcia data center
notes: ITRES operates a Murcia-area CPD in Alcantarilla with 700 sqm of facilities, 33 racks installed, 88-rack capacity, redundant power, cooling and fiber interconnection to Valencia and Madrid.

name: Madrid Sur
notes: Iberdrola describes Madrid Sur as its first DPC/data center JV project, with 144MW processing capacity, 230MW electrical connection and a 160,000 sqm complex in the Madrid region.

name: Iron Mountain Madrid campus / MAD-1
notes: Iron Mountain lists MAD-1 at Calle Mar Egeo 4, San Fernando de Henares, with 3MW current capacity and up to 79MW planned across a 60,000 sqm campus.

name: Nabiax Alcalá Data Center Campus
notes: Nabiax says the Alcalá campus near Madrid-Barajas has two phases built, delivers 22.3MW IT power and is scalable to 100MW maximum IT power.

name: DATA4 Madrid MAD02 San Agustín del Guadalix campus
notes: Invest in Spain reported DATA4's second Madrid campus in San Agustín del Guadalix would have over 16,000 sqm of IT space across four buildings, 80MW total power and 12MW IT power; DATA4 lists MAD02 as a Madrid campus.

name: Digital Realty MAD5
notes: Madrid Investment Attraction reports Digital Realty's fifth Madrid data center, MAD5, in the MaDBit/Julián Camarillo area, with 20-24MW capacity and about EUR300m investment; land acquisition completed.

name: Equinix MD6 / MD3x Madrid
notes: Equinix announced MD6 in Alcobendas as a leased IBX portion of the MD3x/xScale facility, with 1,466 sqm, 4.8MW and 600 racks; Equinix also lists MD3x as its first xScale data center in Madrid.

name: Prime Data Centers MAD01 Alcobendas
notes: Prime lists its Madrid campus in Alcobendas as a development/available hyperscale facility with 40MW critical IT load across 25,810 sqm and on-site Iberdrola substation.

name: Ferrovial MAD01 Valdelacasa campus
notes: DCD reports Ferrovial's phased Madrid campus in Valdelacasa starts with MAD01, a 60MW total-capacity facility including 40MW IT load; full campus investment around EUR1bn.

name: Campus Data Navarra
developer: Grupo VDR; Colliers; Quark/Sener technical design
notes: Sener/Quark says Campus Data Navarra will be built in the Gazólaz industrial estate, Cendea de Cizur, 7km from Pamplona, with EUR3.3bn investment, 300MW projected installed capacity and construction/operation phases scheduled 2027-2029.

name: ADI Data Center Euskadi - Bizkaia
developer: Atlantic Data Infrastructure (Euskaltel, Dominion, Teknei, Basque Government)
notes: ADI's Bizkaia facility is being commissioned in two 1MW phases with Uptime Tier IV fault-tolerance; DCD reported first facility due live in H1 2024 and venture ownership/investment structure.

name: ADI Data Center Euskadi - Gipuzkoa / Garaia Technology Park
notes: KREAN says the new ADI building in Garaia Technology Park, Arrasate-Mondragón, Gipuzkoa, will exceed 5,000 sqm and house up to 3MW of IT equipment in two rooms, fitted out in phases.

name: Sarenet Derio data center
notes: Basque Technology Park announcement and DCD report describe Sarenet's new Derio/Zamudio communications-hub facility in Bizkaia as a EUR20m, 1,000 sqm data center with 3MW installed electrical capacity and up to 340 racks.

name: Solaria Basque Country data center grid connection
notes: Solaria announced Red Eléctrica feasibility confirmation for 225MW demand to supply DPC/data centers in the Basque Country; CNMV filing also records a March 2025 related 225MW Basque Country connection notice.

name: Arsys Logroño data center
notes: Arsys opened its La Rioja/Logroño data center in 2009 with capacity for up to 15,000 servers, four 250 sqm data rooms within a 6,000 sqm building, Tier 3/Tier 2 capabilities and PUE reported as 1.45.

name: NXN-VLC1 Valencia
notes: NXN-VLC1 in Valencia's Vara de Quart industrial park is a EUR60m project expected operational in 2026, with 6MW IT capacity across 5,000 sqm including 1,500 sqm of IT space.

name: Kumo Valencia / Paterna Tier IV data center
notes: Kumo lists a Valencia office/data-center address in Paterna and Uptime-grade certifications; DataCenterMap describes the Paterna site as a Tier IV data center with over EUR50m investment.

name: Valencia Digital Port Connect (VDPC) Sagunto data center
developer: Valencia Digital Port Connect / Pygmalion Group
notes: Pygmalion describes a 332,000 sqm strategic digital-infrastructure project aligned with Valencian digitalization strategy; DataCenterMap lists VDPC in Sagunto as supporting subsea cable connectivity and advanced computing for the Barracuda Genoa-Spain cable.

name: NIXVAL / ProRed / Templus Valencia data center cluster
notes: Valencia/Paterna has several operating colocation facilities listed by DataCenterMap, including NIXVAL, ProRed and Templus/Grupo Aire; included as a regional operating cluster where project-level capacity is not publicly stated in the checked sources.

name: IslaLink Valencia/FSL data center and cable landing colocation
notes: IslaLink offers colocation from cable landing stations including Valencia/FSL; DCD notes IslaLink also offers colocation from its Mallorca and Valencia cable landing stations.
